title: Auto-rally duration extended to 12 hours, plus chat announcement fixes
summary: A small hotfix. The first auto-rally (auto-gather) target group now runs for 12 hours instead of 8; the second group stays at 72 hours. In-game announcements in chat are also re-fetched after a reconnect and kept in full instead of being trimmed with ordinary chat history.
highlights: Auto-rally target group 1 duration: 28800 s (8 h) → 43200 s (12 h); rewards, target types and group 2 (72 h) are unchanged
After reconnecting, the game re-pulls the announcement list so announcements pushed while offline are no longer missed
The announcement channel is no longer trimmed to the chat cache limit, so older announcements stay available
Chat window clears pending new-message markers when opening the announcement list or leaving an announcement's detail view, and refreshes the pinned announcement when new messages arrive
